positive.text: The staff were exceptional, Maria remembered our anniversary without us mentioning it
Das Frühstück war absolut erstklassig, frische regionale Produkte
The infinity pool at sunset is worth the trip alone
Una experiencia inolvidable, el trato del personal fue exquisito
La cuisine était à la hauteur de nos attentes — Menorca surprend
The attention to sustainability is visible and authentic, not greenwashing
Direct beach access makes all the difference for a lazy morning
Design-driven architecture, every corner is Instagrammable
Thai Spa hydrothermal circuit is the best on the island
Adults-only atmosphere finally respected — true tranquility

negative.text: Resort fee of €45/night appeared at checkout — not mentioned at booking
Some noise from construction next door during daytime hours
Restaurant menu felt more limited than expected for a 5-star property
Wait for dinner reservation confirmation was unnecessarily long
Breakfast coffee refills were slow — had to ask twice
For the price paid, we expected more dining variety on-site
Spa booking app glitched and we lost our preferred slot
